notation: Object fields below are required unless suffixed with ?. Nullable is explicit. Unlisted existing fields keep their existing source schema. This is design input, not generated or executable code.

ContractCommercialTerms.receivablePlanSeeds: ReceivablePlanSeed[] length>=1, unique nodeKey and sortOrder, sum=contract inclusive cents

ReviewCommercialReleaseBaselineDiffReque.attachmentIds: uuid[] default[]; deduplicated; real authorized same-project/contract active links

CreateContractRequest.signedAmount: required positive exact numeric(18,2) decimal string

add.contractTerms: ContractCommercialTerms[]|null when sensitive projection hides financial terms

replaceWithRequiredFields.targetId: uuid = actual preparation id for A08, actual plan version id for A09

ReadinessInitializationResult.A09: targetType=receivable-plan-version/resultStatus=initialized/businessStatusAfter=active; actual source preparationId/version, actual snapshotId, newVersionId=planVersionId, actual planVersion/initRecordId all nonnull

projection.A: Existing auth::projection::plan with ContractFinancePackage. Unauthorized: old scalar money/ratio/payment text and summaries null, contractTerms/candidateTerms null, financialProjection mode masked, diff old/new values and package item free-text summaries masked. Metadata IDs/status/version/prepared binding stay readable. Actual pending security event and auth flush in same successful read transaction. No hidden raw values in audit or display text.
projection.B: Retain all original per-field signedAmount/currentTermsSnapshot projections and events. New preparation/binding summaries contain only identities/version/hash/status/time, no raw terms. Snapshot sourcePreparationId is metadata.
projection.C: Preserve current finance permission policy; this batch does not add a new role or assert unavailable business ownership. Necessary operation audit remains transactionally required.

sharedCodeBoundary: Root implements Shared/DTO/OpenAPI/client/Rust-generated/UI changes after G1. Native historical reference cannot be made conformant by filling fake preparation/snapshot/plan IDs; legacy Node defects and new Rust correctness are separate evidence classes. Any compile adapter must report actual nullable absence or use explicit legacy local typing, never fabricated domain products.
